text:
maria.pm: Quick heads-up — ran the post-demo survey with 12 pilot customers; wanted to share the signal before the roadmap sync.

maria.pm: TL;DR: strong interest in 1) burst/bucket credits, 2) 'priority lane' add-on for tail-latency, 3) smaller starter SKUs for internal teams.

leah.sales: +1. Heard this repeatedly in calls — customers want a low-friction starter at ~$200/mo and optional burst credits.

akshay.eng: Engineering note: supporting burst credits + priority lanes implies per-customer quota logic + routing policy changes. Rough estimate: 3 sprint work + infra hooks.

omar.finance: Need to model unit economics. If starter SKU = $200/mo, assumed usage 50k tokens => ~X margin loss unless we gate burst. Propose: starter includes 25k tokens, extra tokens billed; burst = prepaid credit packs.

maria.pm: Survey snippets: "We'd pay for guaranteed QoS during peak times" — CFO of fintech pilot. "Starter tier for internal tooling would help scale usage" — infra lead at scaling SaaS.

marvin-bot: deploy-notify: survey-results.csv uploaded to GDrive: https://drive.redwood/surveys/2391112222

dan.growth: Also saw correlation in product analytics: 40% of trial teams never hit 100k tokens/mo. Means smaller SKUs could shorten sales cycle.

katie.legal: Heads-up: priority lane + SLA implies contract-level commitments. Legal needs guardrails for force majeure, capacity fallback, and clear overage terms. Also data residency asks for Private customers.

akshay.eng: Two engineering options: (A) lightweight: implement prepaid burst credits + simple token meter; defer routing changes to Q3. (B) full: include priority lane routing (needs routing policy + dedicated queues) — 6 sprints.

maria.pm: Proposal: phased launch: Phase 1 = starter SKU + burst credit packs (deliverable in 6 weeks), Phase 2 = priority lane add-on (Q3). Launch criteria for Phase 1: 3 pilot customers commit OR predicted ARR >= $25k/mo from early adopters + legal signoff on T&Cs.

omar.finance: If we do prepaid burst credits, we should offer 3 pack sizes: 50k, 200k, 1M tokens. Prices to target ~30% margin after infra cost. Will share modeled sheet.

leah.sales: Ask: allow sales to bundle one free small burst pack for pilot customers during POC. Helps conversion.

katie.legal: Acceptable if we add clause that free credits expire in 30 days and are non-refundable.

akshay.eng: Implementation detail: expose `burst_credit_id` in API header so runtime can account. Minimal runtime changes: add token bucket per tenant, enforce on request accept/reject or fall back to cheaper model.

maria.pm: Dev acceptance criteria for Phase 1: 1) API accepts prepaid credits and decrements correctly under load, 2) Billing ties credits to invoice, 3) Docs + console showing remaining credits.

dan.growth: KPI to watch post-launch: conversion lift from trial -> paid, average revenue per customer, frequency of burst pack purchases. Suggest A/B: show 'burst pack' CTA vs no CTA to random 10% of trials.

omar.finance: Also need to set contract guardrail: if a single customer uses >10% of shared capacity repeatedly, shift to Dedicated or cap throughput.

maria.pm: Decision ask for this thread: approve Phase 1 (starter SKU + prepaid burst packs) and prioritize engineering option (A). If approved, akshay, please slot 3 sprints and draft scope doc.

akshay.eng: I can do option A in 3 sprints if we reduce scope: no UI for credits in sprint 1 (API + billing only), sprint 2 add console view, sprint 3 harden + tests.

leah.sales: Approved from GTM — we need battlecards and pricing guidance asap.

omar.finance: Approved contingent on modeled margins in shared spreadsheet. Will review tonight.

katie.legal: Approved contingent on T&Cs addendum draft (I’ll start).

maria.pm: OK — consensus seems positive. Next steps: akshay to post scope doc by EOD tomorrow, marvin-bot to attach survey CSV and modeled pricing sheet, legal to prepare addendum draft. Meeting to finalize pricing: Friday 10am.

marvin-bot: files updated: survey-results.csv, pricing-model.xlsx (links in thread).

leah.sales: Thanks — I’ll prep two customer quote excerpts to use in the deck.

maria.pm: Great — will capture launch acceptance criteria and put PRD draft in /docs. Thanks team! :rocket:
